_what: Prior-art screen for the four publication endpoints scoring 12.5+, run 2026-08-09 so that 'has anyone already done this?' has a measured answer instead of no answer at all.
_why: The paper-strength rubric has no novelty term and could not answer the question for any of its 28 endpoints (trimcrae, 2026-08-09, asking of the surface-target paper: 'sounds awesome to do if no one has done it yet'). Grading novelty from recollection was refused; this is the retrieval that replaces it.
_no_positive_control_and_why: expect_pmids was left EMPTY deliberately. The workflow's own header records a run that searched 53 minutes, reported success, and had its whole corpus discarded because the control was a paper the author trusted rather than one the query would return. No confident control existed for a prior-art query, so the corpus was screened by hand instead.
⚠_what_a_screen_of_abstracts_can_and_can: This matches titles and abstracts, not full text. An absence here is evidence that nothing is INDEXED on the pairing, and is not proof that no such work exists - a result buried in a supplementary table of a larger paper would be invisible to it. Read every count below as 'nothing indexed', never as 'nobody has done it'.

⭐_the_two_that_change_a_manuscript.17545802: Chow WA, Update on chondrosarcomas, Curr Opin Oncol 2007, doi 10.1097/cco.0b013e32812143d9. Names METHYLTHIOADENOSINE PHOSPHORYLASE among targets 'validated' by translational research in chondrosarcoma, and in the same abstract treats EMC as a distinct fusion-defined entity. ⛔ It does NOT scoop the EMC MTAP/PRMT5 hypothesis - it predates the MTAP-deletion/PRMT5 synthetic-lethality literature entirely and is about the parent histology - but a reviewer will know it, and any sentence claiming MTAP is unexamined in this space must be narrowed to EMC specifically and must cite this.
⭐_the_two_that_change_a_manuscript.41055792: Remiszewski P et al., From pathogenesis to the patient's bedside: a comprehensive review of extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma, J Cancer Res Clin Oncol 2025, doi 10.1007/s00432-025-06316-5, PMC12504171. The current standard EMC reference and the nearest competitor to the repurposing menu. States independently that NO CLINICALLY VALIDATED AGENT DIRECTLY TARGETS NR4A3, and reports pazopanib ORR 18% / median PFS 19 months (NCT02066285). ⭐ It corroborates the categorical-gap premise rather than scooping it, but every one of the four manuscripts is now writing against a 2025 comprehensive review and must cite it and say what it adds.
